name: Night Stalker grants its bonus at night (#1275)
contract: Spell.dbc 807774 triggers 808013 every 10000 ms; 808013 grants +5% damage and +5% healing for 11000 ms.
808013 carries SPELL_ATTR0 0x2000 'Only usable during nighttime'; every text source grants the bonus at night.
